'''C3-L1''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]],<ref name="RASB" /> a type of [[Class three droid/Legends|class three droid]]<ref name="SECR">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]'' establishes that [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]] were [[Class three droid/Legends|class three droid]]s.</ref> designed for interacting with organic beings.<ref name="NEGtD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was owned by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Busurra]], who was an assistant to [[Loom Carplin]], the [[Chief of Staff/Legends|Chief of Staff]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Atrivis Sector Force|forces]] in [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] at some point between the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. As many [[Human/Legends|Humans]] had difficulty understanding Busurra&mdash;the Wookiee was unable to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]&mdash;C3-L1 was his constant companion, [[Translator droid/Legends|translating]] his words for others to understand.<ref name="RASB" />

==Behind the scenes==
C3-L1 was created by [[Paul Murphy]] for the ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', which was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1990]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="First">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref>
